## Checklist

- [ ] `./gradlew spotlessCheck check koverVerify apiCheck` passes
- [ ] New behavior has tests, and sandbox changes have a hostile-app test on the platform they touch
- [ ] `./gradlew apiDump` was run, if the public API changed
- [ ] The README table still matches what was actually run
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under `## [Unreleased]`
